abstract: Data collection of biodiversity and environmental data for D3.3 of task 3.3 comprising the 4 case study regions Danube - Black Sea, Elbe – North Sea, Guadalquivir – Atlantic Ocean and Po – Adriatic Sea since year 2000
description: Data collection for D3.3 of task 3.3 comprising data of the 4 case study regions Danube - Black Sea, Elbe – North Sea, Guadalquivir – Atlantic Ocean and Po – Adriatic Sea since year 2000: Collected were fish, macrozoobenthos and phytoplankton data as well as matching environmental measurements in the freshwater, transitional and coastal/marine zone. Continuous data in the river-to-sea continuum was enquired. Environmental data had to originate from the same water body as the biodiversity data. Data was excluded, if the data type or parameter was unclear, if coordinates of the sampling location were missing and could not be retraced, if units were missing or if there were uncertainties about the sampling.
name: T3.3: Collecting source data
